title: Representative short exact sequence for the coefficient layer
statement: Let X be a scheme, (A,I) an adic coefficient datum, M a derived completed-coefficient object, and n≥0. There exists a short exact sequence S of cochain complexes of sheaves over the successor finite coefficient ring such that the derived objects Q(S.X₁), Q(S.X₂), and Q(S.X₃) are respectively isomorphic to the explicit coefficient layer, the actual successor reduction, and the explicit previous object.

source.place: Tag 0942, lemma-bounded, proof (1): choose a flat-term K-flat representative and tensor the kernel-unit-quotient sequence.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative of the successor reduction and tensor the actual kernel-unit-quotient sequence degreewise; exactness gives a short exact sequence of cochain complexes over the successor ring.

Use derived tensor representative comparison, tensor-unit comparison, scalar-extension associativity, and the completed projection composition equality to identify the three derived endpoints with the explicit layer, successor, and previous objects.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteQuotient_coefficient_layer_core
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} (completedAdicFiniteRing X d (n + 1))) ℤ),
      S.ShortExact ∧
      Nonempty (finiteQuotientLayerObject X d M n ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₁) ∧
      Nonempty ((completedAdicQuotientReduction X d (n + 1)).obj M ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₂) ∧
      Nonempty (finiteQuotientPreviousObject X d M n ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₃)
